# zs-table subtotal pattern
A Vue table technique for showing a summed subtotal row on contract filing list pages.
## Usage
- Set showSummary: true in the list page data object.
- Implement showMethod to sum contractAmount and format as two decimals with thousand separators.
- Show 「小计」(subtotal) in the first column.
## Scope
- Applies to resourcesLeaseContractFiling, assetsLeaseContractFiling, parkingSpaceContractFiling list pages.
- Remove redundant ">" from zs-table markup.

# zs-input-number
A custom number-input component used across the zhi2-web-admin Vue project.
## Purpose
- Replaces <el-input-number> in 49 business page templates.
- Registered globally in main.js, so pages need no import.
## Implementation
- zs-input-number.vue still wraps el-input-number at the bottom layer.
- Sync style changes in element-ui.scss and zs-search-form.vue.

# VerificationReceiptDetailTable
A Vue component that renders the receipt verification detail table.
## Behavior
- queryParams includes receiptVerifyFilter:1 to auto-attach a filter condition.
- List requests spread ...this.queryParams when calling /benefit/pubReceiptVerificationDetail/page.
## Fix
- Added receiptVerifyFilter:1 to queryParams so page requests auto-carry the filter.

- Wrap 「附件图片」(attachment images) and 「备注」(remarks) into a new Headline block 「其他信息」(other info) to reuse the margin-top:12px block spacing.
- Add v-if="formMode != 'view'" to the edit block to prevent duplicate display with regulatoryInfo's DetailTemplate view mode.
